name: ai.agentroam/agentroam
title: AgentRoam
description: Buy travel eSIMs, gift cards and mobile top-ups with crypto — user confirms before any order.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the AgentRoam travel-crypto catalog: gift cards (Airbnb, Uber, airlines, 500+ US brands), eSIM data plans (110+ destinations incl. Europe/Global region plans) and mobile top-ups (carriers in 100+ countries). Returns product handles (brandSlug + countryCode) used by the pricing and order tools. Creates no order.

query.description: Brand, carrier or destination to search for

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Live crypto price for one product/denomination. Payment coins include USDT, USDC, BTC (incl. Lightning), ETH, SOL, DAI, PYUSD, LTC, TRX, TON, DOGE and SUI across many networks; get_payment_methods returns the current set. Creates no order.

denomination_label.description: Exact denomination label (e.g. "100 USD", "60 UC", "1 GB 7 days")

dynamic.description: true for dynamic-range amounts, false for fixed denomination labels

coin.description: Payment coin, e.g. USDC, USDT, BTC, SOL

network.description: Exact network string from get_price/networks, e.g. "Solana", "Tron", "ETH Mainnet"

tools.name: validate_order
tools.description: Dry-run an order and mint a one-time confirm_token (valid 10 minutes). Returns a human-readable purchase summary for the buyer to approve, plus the one-time token that create_order requires. Creates no order and reserves no funds.

denomination_label.description: Exact denomination label (e.g. "100 USD", "60 UC", "1 GB 7 days")

dynamic.description: true for dynamic-range amounts, false for fixed denomination labels

coin.description: Payment coin, e.g. USDC, USDT, BTC, SOL

network.description: Exact network string from get_price/networks, e.g. "Solana", "Tron", "ETH Mainnet"

phone.description: Phone number to recharge (REQUIRED for mobile top-ups, with country code)

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Creates the real order. Requires a confirm_token minted by validate_order. Returns the payment wallet address, exact crypto amount, 30-minute expiry, and an order-status URL. The purchased code/QR is emailed by Cryptorefills to the buyer — it is never returned here.

confirm_token.description: One-time token returned by validate_order (valid 10 minutes)

full_name.description: Buyer full legal name — only if a previous attempt returned FULLNAME_MISSING

tools.name: list_esim_plans
tools.description: Live eSIM data plans for a destination (110+ countries, plus "eu" Europe and "ww" Global multi-country plans) with USD prices and crypto amounts. In clients that support widgets, the response also renders an interactive plan picker. Creates no order by itself.

destination.description: Destination: 2-letter country code (e.g. "il", "jp", "fr"), or "eu" (Europe region plan) / "ww" (Global plan)

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Poll order state (WAITING_FOR_PAYMENT → PARTIAL → COMPLETED, or CANCELED/EXPIRED). Requires the status_token from create_order.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: Browse all available brands/carriers for a country: gift cards (500+ US brands) and mobile top-up carriers (100+ countries). Creates no order.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List a brand's live products/denominations with prices in the chosen coin — including the exact denomination labels the pricing and order tools expect (eSIM destinations are covered by list_esim_plans). Creates no order.

tools.name: get_currencies
tools.description: List all supported payment cryptocurrencies (the response carries the current set).

tools.name: get_payment_methods
tools.description: Full payment matrix: every supported coin × network combination currently available, with the exact network strings orders require. The response includes live totals for coins, networks and combinations.

tools.name: purchase_wizard
tools.description: Stateful text-only purchase flow for clients without widget support. Called repeatedly with the same session_token, one question at a time, until status is "complete"; the first call takes empty arguments. The final "confirm" answer creates a real order.

session_token.description: Omit on the first call — a new session is minted

action.description: "back" to return to the previous step
